//: SERVER UPDATE LAYER — always loaded LAST, on top of every other appsettings file, in every environment (see Program.cs). Its purpose is the offline updater: a server patched in the field keeps the customer's own connection string and secrets in appsettings.Production.json, and this file carries only the values the update itself must force through (a new update feed, a temporarily disabled feature, a staged rollout flag). Because it wins over everything, an operator overrides this deployment without touching the production file. Leave this file at its shipped state unless a specific update says otherwise.

UpdateFeed.//: The feed the running build asks about updates. An update package may ship a new URL so the fielded build learns where the next one lives.
